review.summary: Locally animated motion study follows the verified single left slide, vertical green triple, one lock release, first gravity, female-character horizontal cascade, and second gravity. The resulting board retains the planned survivor identities without replenishment or a win.
review.method: Deterministic cropped-image animation, not a recorded playthrough or an AI-generated video. The clip is explicitly labeled LOCAL MOTION MOCKUP.
review.first_frame: The full Polished Image board, four locks, tutorial glove and Play Free CTA remain visible. Only the small provenance label is added in the empty top margin; the image is uniformly fitted into 1080×1920.
review.input_causality: The glove fades out before input. A touch ring follows the green 發 tile left along row 5 into the single adjacent empty cell, with no vertical drag.
review.first_clear: At 5.1s the three green tiles at r4–r6 c5 and only the lock across r4c4–r4c5 are gone. The other three locks remain.
review.cascade_and_survivors: At 7.3s the source r3c5 female tile has joined the two female tiles at r6c6/r6c7. At 10.8s all three have cleared. The final affected area contains two red 中 in c5 at r5/r6; c6 two-dot, wreath, female, wreath at r3–r6; c7 two-dot, two-dot, wreath, green 發, female at r2–r6. No new tiles or extra clears appear.
review.vfx_and_camera: Small aligned outlines, short rings and sparse particles keep the cleared cells readable. Fixed camera preserves the full board and CTA. Effect timing is stored in the request record.
review.ui: Preserves the actual Polished Image green board and Play Free CTA. No new counters, scores, rewards or victory UI are added.
review.audio: FFprobe confirms AAC stereo, 48 kHz, 12 seconds. Narration was generated from the plan using installed generic macOS Samantha; original procedural SFX/music were mixed locally. PCM was non-silent with peak 0.560 and RMS 0.070. Audio was not listened to during this review.
fidelity_limitations: Locally animated mockup, not an engine recording or a model-generated video.
Covered background is approximated from the same screenshot; occluded tile art uses identical-symbol donors.
Retains the Polished Image green board and Play Free CTA, which differ from the original playable screenshot.
Timing and effects are a design study; no implementation or playable interaction is included.
The screenshot glove and removable lock hide parts of several tiles. Matching same-image symbol donors reconstruct them; exact per-tile painted texture and bevel edges therefore differ slightly.
The newly exposed green board is reconstructed from sampled source colors and texture, so its lighting/texture is smoother and small seams can remain around the edited region.
Sampled frames and deterministic state maps were checked; this does not validate a game-engine implementation.
